report_note: Checks dietary-pattern interpretation and source grounding without a fully dense HealthKit profile.

preference_notes: I want meals that support heart health.
I want to lower saturated fat.

response.calorie_rationale: Use the provided 1800 kcal serving row as the primary anchor, and it also matches your provisional target closely. With an active-calorie average around 290 kcal and a TDEE of 1780 kcal, 1800 kcal is a reasonable maintenance-oriented target for heart-healthy eating.
response.meal_pattern: Aim for 3 meals with 1 snack, or 4 smaller meals. Build each meal around a protein, a whole grain or starchy plant food, and at least one vegetable, with nuts/seeds or olive oil in moderate amounts.
foods_to_avoid: processed foods high in saturated fat
foods made with partially hydrogenated oils
refined grains and sugary foods eaten in place of whole foods
response.sleep_note: Your average sleep of 7.1 hours is decent; keeping meals balanced and not too heavy late at night may help preserve sleep quality and appetite control.
response.summary: An 1800 kcal pattern is a good fit for your current activity level and supports a heart-health focus. Prioritize omega-3-rich seafood, legumes, soy foods, whole grains, vegetables, fruit, and unsaturated fats like olive oil, walnuts, chia, and flax. Keep saturated fat below 10% of calories by limiting highly processed foods and choosing lower-saturated-fat pescatarian meals. Watch mercury by favoring salmon, sardines, anchovies, and trout more often.
